title: Minimax Robust CATE Prediction from Multiple Randomized Trials without Rank Conditions
banked_reason: D0.5.G delivered tier subfield below field floor, score7.0<7.4, not salvageable in scope; sole anchor citation finding resolved by source-only repair and independent main validity gate.
gap_reasons: The delivered contribution is a matched minimax estimation theorem and conditioning profile for an existing robust prediction target, confined to three trials with scalar public-uniform covariates, known fair randomization, and binary outcomes.
It does not characterize the broader observational or unknown-target-distribution problem, which limits its significance at a leading econometrics journal.
The positive-definite converse concerns moving worst-case laws, and the Gaussian theorem concerns the specified collapsing-triangle family rather than general prediction inference.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived the original-record three-versus-two minimax frontier, conditioning profile, moving-triangle Gaussian limit, and positive-definite translated witnesses. D0.5 stopped on novelty at subfield (7.0 below the field threshold 7.4); its sole residual mathematical finding concerned missing source evidence for the anchor Gram descriptor. Main repaired only that citation and an independent high Codex validity audit verified the match and recommended downgraded banking; no Lean formalization or kernel certification was attempted.
tldr: Robust causal prediction from three labelled randomized trials has sharp full-class squared \(L_2\) risk \(n^{-2\beta/(2\beta+1)}+n^{-1/2}\), attained by a total finite histogram aggregation rule. A common quadratic translation makes the geometric lower-bound laws have strictly positive-definite uncentered Gram matrices while preserving their prediction separations and information upper comparisons. Pointwise positive definiteness therefore retains the three-source ceiling; two sources have only the ordinary regression rate. The same estimator attains the affine-conditioning profile, and the collapsing-triangle Gaussian limit is proved. The full class is a public-uniform, fair-randomized, binary-outcome specialization permitting singular Gram matrices, rather than the identical statistical class of the causal anchor.
gap: The identified robust prediction target has no located matched precision theorem on the supplied class allowing singular source geometry. The closest causal analysis controls weights under positive definiteness; generic regret perturbation bounds do not supply the original-record converse or conditioning continuum.
fill: The package fixes the original-record information, establishes the two-versus-three minimax comparison, and resolves the affine-conditioning transition with one data-only rule. A local-limit question investigates the distributional mechanism at the transition rather than presenting supporting optimization as a new contribution.
